description: This file defines interfaces related to system information and subsystem management within the Thunder PluginHost namespace, including metadata, subsystem status, security, internet, location, identification, time, provisioning, and decryption.

classes.name: IMetadata
classes.description: Interface providing software build metadata such as hash and version numbers.

classes.name: ISubSystem
classes.description: Interface for accessing and managing various system subsystems and their statuses.

classes.name: ISubSystem::INotification
classes.description: Interface for notifications about subsystem updates.

classes.name: ISubSystem::ISecurity
classes.description: Interface for security subsystem information, such as callsign.

classes.name: ISubSystem::IInternet
classes.description: Interface for internet connectivity details, including IP address and network type.

classes.name: ISubSystem::ILocation
classes.description: Interface for location-related information such as timezone, country, and coordinates.

classes.name: ISubSystem::IIdentifier
classes.description: Interface for device identification details like architecture, chipset, and firmware version.

methods.name: BuildTreeHash
methods.description: Returns a hash representing the build tree.

methods.name: NetworkType
methods.description: Returns the network type (IPv4, IPv6, or unknown).

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances to next string in iterator.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves to previous string in iterator.
